workarounds.symptom: fleet: a target can never release its reservation because nothing sends reservation-accept
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(fleet): expose routing reservation acceptance. Target files: src/brigade/cli/fleet_policy.py, tests/test_fleet_policy_api.py, changelog.d/2846-reservation-accept.md. Routing creates an unaccepted reservation. The hub requires the selected target to accept it before renew or release. The node-authenticated client helper already calls `reservation-accept`, but the CLI exposed only renew and release. (Ref: https://github.com/escoffier-labs/brigade/pull/2855)

workarounds.symptom: paired-live: cell work dir removal races a surviving descendant (Directory not empty)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(model): drain a live cell's process group before removing its work dir. Target files: src/brigade/model_trial_claude.py, src/brigade/proc_group.py, tests/paired_live_fake.py. `execute_live` removed each cell's work dir as soon as `run_cell` returned. `_run_process` ended the arm with one `killpg(SIGKILL)` and then reaped the leader without waiting for the group to be empty. A descendant that was mid-write, such as the MCP server appending and fsyncing `trace.jsonl` under the work dir, could finish that write after... (Ref: https://github.com/escoffier-labs/brigade/pull/2833)

workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(skills): tolerate a symlinked installed skill in doctor, fleet status and sync. The read-only path r... (Ref: https://github.com/escoffier-labs/brigade/pull/2680)

workarounds.symptom: fix(hub): a planned restart sometimes fails the unit when the managed upstream dies from SIGTERM
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(hub): accept planned upstream SIGTERM stops. Target files: engines/hub/src/main.rs, changelog.d/2488.md. Planned restarts failed the hub unit on 2 of 3 production stops in #2487. The front reported a child terminated by SIGTERM as an error and exited 2. The replacement process started normally, with `NRestarts` remaining 0. (Ref: https://github.com/escoffier-labs/brigade/pull/2488)

Target files: src/brigade/work_cmd/scanner_errors.py, src/brigade/work_cmd/scanners.py, tests/test_work_cmd_scanners.py. Distinguish missing files, other read errors and UTF-8 decoding failures. workarounds.symptom: ingest: configured-root gitdir discovery fails on Windows ('gitfile does not point to a valid repository')
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(ingest): never archive handoffs that git tracks. Target files: src/brigade/ingest.py, tests/test_ingest.py. Ingest now skips and reports handoffs tracked by Git, including staged files. `_execute` checks tracking before destination writes, `_archive` checks again before moving the source, and `ingest_into` catches a refusal and counts it as skipped. This prevents routine ingest from deleting committed handoffs from a checkout. (Ref: https://github.com/escoffier-labs/brigade/pull/1836)

workarounds.symptom: fix(work): retry quarantined imports after metadata redaction recovers
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(security): redact acceptance and metadata on generic JSONL import.
